messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front and back views to match the hairstyle shape accurately. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images; do not transfer the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color, identity, and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, turning his body and head to look around while occasionally raising a hand to his chin or chest.","camera":"Static full-body shot from a slightly low angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a pink and purple graphic, pink shorts with white trim, and red slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"White","hairstyle":"Short hair with a white beanie or head wrap on top.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with dark skin, a slim build, and a short beard.","scene":"An outdoor European-style street with cobblestone pavement and ornate stone buildings with shopfronts in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's head covering changed from a smooth white beanie/head wrap to a white top-knot/bun hairstyle with a rounded knot on top, while the rest of the character, clothing, scene, and motion remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, preserving the original hair color, identity, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the new hairstyle accurately matches the reference's front and back shape, since the output only shows a white top knot and the reference shows a more detailed short-cut style with a bun.
